_status: In production use since 2026-10. The eleven layers below have scored live RingCentral tenants and fed customer-facing readouts; they are no longer provisional. Layer membership is what the scorecard renders, so adding or renaming one changes every deliverable — change it deliberately.
model: PacketFusion RingCentral Optimization — layered value model

layers.name: Foundation
layers.description: Account, sites, numbering, emergency addressing, licensing hygiene.

layers.name: Provisioning & Identity
layers.description: Extensions, users, devices, SCIM/directory sync, activation completeness.

layers.name: Call Routing
layers.description: IVR menus, answering rules, business hours, queue design, overflow.

layers.name: Voice Quality & Reliability
layers.description: Device health, network readiness, call failure and disconnect patterns.

layers.name: Employee Experience
layers.description: Presence, DND, app adoption, softphone vs hard phone mix, mobility.

layers.name: Customer Experience
layers.description: Answer rate, speed to answer, abandonment, first-contact resolution.

layers.name: Messaging & Digital
layers.description: SMS/MMS, A2P campaign health, fax displacement, digital channels.

layers.name: Meetings & Collaboration
layers.description: RingCentral Video and Team Chat adoption and meeting hygiene.

layers.name: Contact Center
layers.description: RingCX queues, agents, dispositions, routing effectiveness.

layers.name: AI & Automation
layers.description: AI summaries, transcription, RingSense insights, deflection.

layers.name: Governance & Value
layers.description: Cost per seat, license utilization, compliance posture, realized value.
